decisions.reason: Bleaching tray blanks build directly on the firm's core thermoforming material know-how, and lab feedback is easy to interpret, so the firm can keep refining them at low cost.
PETG thermoforming blanks sit at the centre of the firm's established thermoforming competence and in-house R&D, which makes them a durable part of the range.
The UV-curing lacquer relates to the firm's light-curing expertise, but its marginal web presence and niche role leave a moderate risk of consolidation, not enough yet to drop it.
The intraoral contrast spray supports the digital scanning workflow the firm is expanding into, so the learning it yields complements the strategy even though it sits outside the core materials base.
Custom hearing protection draws on the firm's earmold and digital production know-how, though the withdrawal of the related earmold line E signals some portfolio pruning in this segment.
